parsed.name: 串口实验仪器
parsed.description: 通过串口（如 USB CDC ACM）连接的通用实验室仪器类别，可涵盖控制器、传感器或执行部件。此类设备通常用于实验自动化系统中接收命令、返回状态或测量结果，并与上位机进行持续通信。
parsed.description_en: A generic category of laboratory instruments connected over a serial interface such as USB CDC ACM. This may include controllers, sensors, or actuators used in lab automation systems to receive commands, return status information, or report measurements while maintaining ongoing communication with a host computer.
